visualReview.reviewer: independent QA reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5 subagent), round 2
visualReview.method: Playwright 133/133 re-run (exit 0); DOM-less 5/5 + core 4/4; item-20 check; 60 fps glyph probe qa-glyph.mjs (all presets + es-only x 3 ratios x labels all/key/none, whole timeline); text/overlap probe; wrap probe; independent sized-host lens re-measure; strips viewed
findings: Hold contradiction fixed: no ● on any paused clock/room at any frame in every preset + es-only x ratio x labels all/key/none; ●→◆ cross-fade sequenced (● fades over ~70 ms as the badge rises, never both >= 0.3), 0 doubles, 0 flicker
legend ● row is a key entry, consistent with the scene
text floors: baseline/es/es-only min 19.8 px, others 16.4; no text overlaps, nothing outside frame, no EN in es-only
cosmetic, non-blocking: narrow plates keep one short word per line (e.g. 'Receso / desde / las 10:40 / (aportado)', 'Session / clock (as / supplied)'); no orphan fragments
starts paused: ◆ throughout; legend ● 'Session active (as supplied)' judged acceptable (key entry for the editable states.active field, attached to nothing drawn; no contradiction)

lens re-measured (text-box height ratio, 640x360 el / 800x600 / 1400x1000): min 1.96; smaller side min 0.374 (1:1); context share 0.478/0.465/0.475, lens does not overlap the room so all of it is visible (>= 0.45)
es 9:16: tighter crop, dock tray visible from the start; Δ marker in a free strip beside the dock, clear of text and faces
minor: 1:1/16:9 empty 'was' tray in the lens at u 0.35-0.5 before the old value docks

previousVisualReview.method: Playwright 129/129 re-run (exit 0); DOM-less 5/5 + core 4/4; item-20 field check; DOM text probe (all presets + es-only, 3 ratios, u 0.8/1); sized-host lens re-measure; composite strips viewed
findings: Hold contradiction (coordinator ruling, LAW-0469 class): the ● plate text names the place neutrally ('Session clock (as supplied)' / 'Reloj de sesión (aportado)') in every preset and es-only, BUT the ● glyph on the paused clock's plate is keyed as 'Session active (as supplied)' / 'Sesión activa (aportada)' at the hold, so the hold reads paused clock = session active (kit pausa-audiencia.js pzRows lg-active + plateNode dot): legend lg-active at the return hold beside context label 'The room after the session clock was paused (as supplied)' (es: 'La sala con el reloj de sesión en pausa' + 'Sesión activa'), every preset x ratio
lens re-measured independently (text-box height ratio, 640x360 element, 800x600, 1400x1000): min 1.786 (1:1 baseline-es/es-only), smaller side min 0.374 (1:1 alt); matches builder
minor: 9:16 u 0.35-0.5 lens right ~45% is bare panel surface until the dock arrives; dark lens title bar carries no text
session clock and card dial both move to the after-time consistently; Δ marker on the caption plate's right border, clear of text and faces
min figure rest 1:1 73.3 px, lens 51.2 px
